package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for first_or_create_in_loop: GORM FirstOrCreate(...) chains observed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule264PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario264Positive(db *gorm.DB, names []string) error {
	for _, name := range names {
		var item Rule264PositiveRecord
		if err := db.Where("name = ?", name).FirstOrCreate(&item).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
